system.description: Advanced Move. When you publicly proclaim a warning, judgment, or belief, those nearby notice and listen to your words; roll+WIS.

success.label: Success!
success.value:
Choose three:
• Your words don't attract unwanted attention.
• You can ask your listeners one question as if you had Scrutinized them collectively.
• Choose a listener - they now Favor you.
• Your listeners start collaboratively working towards something you choose (build a bridge, burn a manor, acquire a treasure, etc.).
